domain-information: An author makes a manuscript submission to the editor for review.
An author revises the manuscript after receiving editorial feedback from the editor.
An author sends the Publishing Request to the publisher for printing.
An editor reviews new manuscript submissions for potential publication.
An editor provides feedback to help the author strengthen their writing.
An editor checks the proof to ensure all edits were correctly applied.
An editor sends a publishing approval after approving the final manuscript.
A publisher reviews a publishing submission.
A publisher issues a print job for a book.
A publisher approves budgets for authors.
A publisher negotiates contracts with authors for upcoming titles.

domain objects.name: Author
domain objects.description: A writer who creates and submits manuscripts for publication.

domain objects.name: Book
domain objects.description: A completed and published work based on an author’s manuscript.

domain objects.name: Final Proof
domain objects.description: The finalized version of a book prepared for printing.

domain objects.name: Publisher
domain objects.description: An organization that approves, funds, and manages book production.

domain objects.name: Manuscript
domain objects.description: The original written work produced by the author.

domain objects.name: Manuscript Submission
domain objects.description: A document package containing the author’s manuscript sent for editorial review.

domain objects.name: Editorial Approval
domain objects.description: An editor’s confirmation that a manuscript is ready for publishing.

domain objects.name: Editor
domain objects.description: A professional who reviews manuscripts and provides editorial feedback.

domain objects.name: Editorial Feedback
domain objects.description: Comments and suggestions from the editor to improve the manuscript.

domain objects.name: Publishing Submission
domain objects.description: The author’s request to publish the final proof through the publisher.

domain objects.name: Budget
domain objects.description: Funds allocated by the publisher to support the publication process.

domain objects.name: Print Job
domain objects.description: An order created by the publisher to print copies of a finished book.

domain objects.name: Contract
domain objects.description: A formal agreement defining rights and responsibilities between the author and publisher.

associations.description: An Author sends a Manuscript Submission for editorial review.

A Budget supports the Author’s publishing process.
A Publisher issues a Print Job to produce printed copies of the Book.
